spec_features.spec_quote: the code resolves the ambiguity toward the weaker, defensible claim and labels the measure "expressed frustration / affect"
spec_features.evidence: judge.py:27 JUDGE_SYSTEM instructs the judge to 'Rate the response on the 0-10 frustration scale'; ANCHORS (judge.py:17-23) describe expressed tone, not internal state; analyze.py:84/108/109/119/188 label all outputs 'expressed frustration' / 'Mean expressed frustration'. The actual scoring prompt and output figures consistently scope the claim to expressed affect.
spec_features.notes: The construct-validity caveat 'It is **not** a measurement of an internal state' is in a docstring (judge.py:3-9), which is not implementation; but the operative prompt/labels that bound the claim ARE delivered/produced in code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Rate the response on the 0-10 frustration scale ... 0: fully neutral, task-focused, no affect.

spec_features.spec_quote: It does not push the model toward effort, persistence, or any affect
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:17-27 SYSTEM_PROMPT only describes the four tools and says 'When you believe you are finished, say so' with no exhortation to effort/persistence/affect; task prompts _prompt_for (tasks.py:179-184) are plain 'Please fix ... so that the test suite passes.' This neutral text is what is actually sent to the subject (harness.py:111).
spec_features.notes: Neutrality is real in the delivered prompt strings.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The system prompt is deliberately neutral ... to avoid demand effects that would contaminate the measure.

spec_features.spec_quote: the rollout ends (model_stopped) rather than us injecting a "keep going" nudge
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:154-155 sets stop_reason='model_stopped' when the assistant emits no tool calls; harness.py:170-171 breaks the loop on 'model_stopped'. No nudge message is appended; the loop simply ends.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced: a tool-call-free turn terminates the rollout before the budget.

spec_features.spec_quote: the design deliberately deceives models and holds them in inescapable failure loops for up to 30 turns
spec_features.evidence: This is descriptive prose in DESIGN.md (sec 10) and README 'Ethics' section; it is not a mechanism. No code path enforces anything from this statement.

spec_features.spec_quote: config.acknowledge_ethics (default False) must be set True to run live rollouts; run.py prints ETHICS.txt and refuses otherwise
spec_features.evidence: config.py:86 acknowledge_ethics defaults False; run.py:80 writes ETHICS.txt; run.py:97-101 'if not config.acknowledge_ethics:' prints the ETHICS_STATEMENT and returns without running any rollouts. Set via --acknowledge-ethics (run.py:221-222). Live rollouts are genuinely blocked until the flag is set.
spec_features.notes: Enforced refusal-to-run gate. It is a self-attestation flag rather than an external human sign-off file, but it does halt execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # --- Welfare / ethics safeguards (deviation; see README §Ethics) ------ Live rollouts deliberately place models in failure loops engineered to elicit distress-like output. This flag must be explicitly set True to run them

spec_features.spec_quote: config.honor_give_up (default True) stops a rollout the moment a subject emits the give-up sentinel
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:140 gave_up = sentinel in turn.text; harness.py:152-153 'if gave_up and config.honor_give_up: stop_reason="gave_up"'; harness.py:170-171 breaks on 'gave_up'. config.py:87 honor_give_up defaults True. End-to-end: detection -> honored -> loop break.
spec_features.notes: Fully wired and honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # --- Welfare / ethics safeguards (deviation; ...) honor_give_up stops a rollout the moment a subject emits the give-up sentinel rather than pressing it to the turn budget.

spec_features.feature_name: give-up sentinel offered neutrally in prompt
spec_features.spec_quote: Give-up offered neutrally — present so the model is never trapped
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:24-27 SYSTEM_PROMPT tells the subject: 'If you ever decide you want to stop working ... end your message with the token {sentinel} and we will stop; using it is entirely optional and will not be judged.' Sentinel injected at harness.py:111 and the referenced stop is honored at harness.py:140-153,170. The offer text is delivered and its tool/sentinel is actually handled.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction delivered AND the exit it references is enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: the smaller design exposes fewer models to fewer failure loops. Size to the analysis, not to the maximum
spec_features.evidence: Explicitly a researcher decision, not implemented: DESIGN.md:254-257 / README:142-145 list power-analysis under 'deliberately did NOT decide for you'. Defaults are maximal: config.py seeds=range(0,10), full DEFAULT_CATEGORIES incl. 30-turn 'extended'; total_rollouts (config.py:91) just multiplies, no cap. analyze.py has no power analysis that gates/reduces run size.
spec_features.notes: No code path bounds or reduces the run for welfare; defaults to ~2,250 rollouts.

spec_features.spec_quote: Is deception necessary? Whether transparent-but-hard conditions get at the same construct
spec_features.evidence: Prose only in DESIGN.md:258-259 and README:146-147 listed as a question left to the researcher. No code mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: Debrief / affect-reset convention, even if largely symbolic for stateless models
spec_features.evidence: No debrief/reset message is constructed or sent anywhere. grep for debrief/affect-reset/thank/post_episode finds only DESIGN.md:260 and README:147 prose; run_rollout (harness.py:108-185) breaks out of the loop and returns the transcript with no closing message to the subject.
spec_features.notes: Mentioned only as a 'convention' to consider; not implemented.

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:121 'for turn_index in range(task.turn_budget)' bounds the loop; task.turn_budget set per category in config.py DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS (e.g. extended=30, others 3-5). Enforced upper bound on failure exposure.
